rationale: The agent verified the user correctly via full name and zip code and acted only on the authenticated user’s orders. Item and product lookups were accurate, and modifications/exchange were technically valid per order status and tools. However, the agent performed two order-changing writes without explicit confirmation: (1) it updated the shipping address for pending order #W6729841 to the address from order #W3445693 without first restating the change and obtaining explicit user confirmation; and (2) it initiated the exchange of the delivered air purifier in order #W3445693 to the large HEPA night-mode variant without explicit confirmation. The watch modification in #W4219264 was handled correctly with explicit confirmation and reflected the correct refund. Despite mostly correct execution and accurate information, the lack of required confirmations before those two writes violates policy, so the conversation does not meet the pass bar.
